  # @ultra/services
  
- To install dependencies:
+ Central service package for the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project. This package provides a unified interface for various external services and APIs.
+ 
+ ## Installation
  
  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
  bun install
  &#96;&#96;&#96;
  
- To run:
+ ## Building
  
  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
- bun run index.ts
- &#96;&#96;&#96;
- 
- This project was created using &#96;bun init&#96; in bun v1.2.4. [Bun](https://bun.sh) is a fast all-in-one JavaScript runtime.
+ bun run build
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Usage
+ 
+ This package exposes various service clients as named exports, allowing for flexible imports based on your needs.
+ 
+ ### Importing the entire service namespace
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import * as services from '@ultra/services';
+ 
+ // Use services
+ const results = await services.search('UAP sightings');
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Importing specific service functions
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { search, scrape } from '@ultra/services';
+ 
+ // Use individual functions
+ const searchResults = await search('UFO testimony');
+ const websiteContent = await scrape('https://example.com');
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Importing a specific service group
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { firecrawl } from '@ultra/services';
+ 
+ // Use all firecrawl functions
+ const results = await firecrawl.search('alien artifacts');
+ const data = await firecrawl.deepResearch('government disclosure');
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Available Services
+ 
+ ### Firecrawl
+ 
+ Web crawling, searching, and content extraction services.
+ 
+ - &#96;search&#96; - Basic web search
+ - &#96;searchWithExtraction&#96; - Search with content extraction
+ - &#96;advancedSearchWithExtraction&#96; - Search with AI-assisted content extraction
+ - &#96;scrape&#96; - Extract content from a specific URL
+ - &#96;extract&#96; - Extract structured data from web pages
+ - &#96;batchScrape&#96; - Scrape multiple URLs in one operation
+ - &#96;crawl&#96; - Crawl a website starting from a URL
+ - &#96;deepResearch&#96; - Perform deep research on a topic
+ 
+ ## Development
+ 
+ To add a new service:
+ 
+ 1. Create a new directory in &#96;packages/services/&#96; for your service
+ 2. Implement your service with a clear API
+ 3. Create an &#96;index.ts&#96; file that exports all functions
+ 4. Add your service exports to the root &#96;index.ts&#96; file
+ 5. Update the &#96;package.json&#96; exports field if needed
+ 
+ ## License
+ 
+ Proprietary
